about me

i am a creative.

I’m Bryan, a junior at Stanford studying Design on the Climate & Environment pathway, with a minor in physics. My work moves between physical products, interfaces, and art, and most of it is about designing for the planet.

Recently that’s meant designing handbags at Simone Accessories in South Korea, leading mechanical design for a rainwater catchment system, and researching wastewater treatment in Stanford’s Civil & Environmental Engineering department.

what drives you?

Doing what’s helpful to people, impactful, and silly.

one message for everyone?

Making fun stuff is awesome.
